description: Collection summary for the passive, logged-out public bet-feed capture of 7-9 October 2026. Figures over the whole corpus are computed from private raw files that are not distributed; they cannot be re-derived from this repository.
collector_note: The collector (not distributed) opened https://500.casino/towers logged out in a browser, recorded the socket.io new_casino_bet frames the page received, and wrote each transactionId once. It placed no bets and sent no messages. Its own de-duplication counter (status.json counts.dup) is the number of repeated frames it skipped.
privacy: Other players’ usernames, avatar URLs, account levels, roles and stable account ids are not distributed. Transaction ids are withheld because payout verification does not need them; raw_line_sha256 lets the holder of the private raw corpus prove lineage without revealing the line.
